logs.summary: The 13th COVID-19 wave has likely crested in the US, but the country heads into winter with low short-term immunity comparable to 2021-2022, a highly divergent variant circulating, and falling vaccination rates. incidents.summary:
New drought developments include exceptional drought in northern Wisconsin for only the second time on record, nearly 70% of California now abnormally dry, and Cass and Clay counties in ND/MN fully in extreme drought. Drought impacts accelerated an Arkansas lake renovation, triggered tree falls in North Carolina, and are expected to mute Wisconsin's fall foliage, while Upper Michigan faces ongoing drought and wildfire risk. Some areas saw improvement: rainfall in the KELOLAND region eased dry conditions, and Maharashtra, India announced upcoming drought relief measures.
A new scientific study suggests a 27-year megadrought in the US may never end due to climate change. Meanwhile, PAGASA forecasts a very strong El Niño persisting into early 2027. In India, Karnataka’s opposition protested meager drought assistance, while micro-irrigation projects advance in drought-hit Kadapa.

logs.summary: The selected news reports widespread drought impacts globally. In the U.S., Lake Powell hit a record low, and Amarillo entered Stage 1 drought contingency. The UK saw Wessex Water impose its first hosepipe ban since 1976, and drought worsened in southern Queensland, Australia. Germany's Rhine River remained low, threatening navigation, and the NFU warned of crop failures. Other reports highlighted severe drought in Wisconsin, reduced grain harvests in Germany, and the potential for a super El Niño affecting Latin America and Sri Lanka.

logs.summary:
New drought developments include exceptional drought in northern Wisconsin for only the second time on record, nearly 70% of California now abnormally dry, and Cass and Clay counties in ND/MN fully in extreme drought. Drought impacts accelerated an Arkansas lake renovation, triggered tree falls in North Carolina, and are expected to mute Wisconsin's fall foliage, while Upper Michigan faces ongoing drought and wildfire risk. Some areas saw improvement: rainfall in the KELOLAND region eased dry conditions, and Maharashtra, India announced upcoming drought relief measures.
A new scientific study suggests a 27-year megadrought in the US may never end due to climate change. Meanwhile, PAGASA forecasts a very strong El Niño persisting into early 2027. In India, Karnataka’s opposition protested meager drought assistance, while micro-irrigation projects advance in drought-hit Kadapa.

Death toll reports vary, with some sources citing at least 188 killed and others reporting over 3,800 deaths, while more than 68,000 people remain missing. Survivors face water shortages, and international aid and domestic relief efforts are underway.

logs.summary:
A powerful earthquake, initially measured at magnitude 7.1 (later revised to 6.8), struck Kumamoto Prefecture in southern Japan on July 28, 2026, at 4:27 p.m. local time. The quake caused the partial collapse of the Aeon Mall in Kashima, trapping many people and leaving an unknown number dead, while injuring at least 50 others and causing widespread damage including fires, power outages, and damage to historic Kumamoto Castle.
A 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck southern Japan's Kyushu island near Kumamoto on July 28, 2026, causing a shopping mall to partially collapse with multiple people trapped and feared dead. The quake knocked out power to thousands of homes, ruptured roads, triggered a temporary tsunami advisory, and left dozens injured, with up to 30 mall employees missing after an explosion.

logs.summary: Severe thunderstorms, tornadoes, and flash flooding impacted multiple regions across the United States from August 20–24, 2026. Confirmed tornadoes struck in Atlantic Beach (Long Island), Dover (Delaware), and York/Lancaster counties (Pennsylvania), while prolonged power outages from earlier storms left thousands without electricity in Gary, Indiana, for over a week. Widespread damage from downed trees, damaged homes, and flooding was reported in the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, and Midwest.

logs.summary:
A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Indonesia's Flores region near Ende on August 14, 2026, toppling buildings and killing at least two people. The shallow quake triggered a tsunami warning for four provinces, prompting mass evacuations before the alert was later lifted. Several strong aftershocks were reported.
The death toll from the magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Ende, Indonesia has risen to at least 38, with dozens injured and many buildings collapsed or damaged. Rescuers are searching for survivors in affected areas, and tsunami waves of less than 1 meter were recorded in several locations before the warning was lifted.

news.headline: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes off Indonesia, tsunami warning issued - West Hawaii Today
news.body: JAKARTA (Reuters) — An earthquake of magnitude 7.7 and several aftershocks struck off the coast of eastern Indonesia early on Saturday, the nation’s geophysics agency BMKG said, while tsunami waves of less than 1 metre (3 feet) were recorded in several areas. Many rushed from their homes, but there were no initial reports of damage from the quake, which was felt strongly for around one minute in regions such as Nagekeo and Bima, said Dodi Yuleova, the spokesperson for the national disaster mitigation agency. A video on Facebook, verified by Reuters as located at a port in Maumere, the main town in Sikka Regency on Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, showed parts of a building collapsing in dust and rubble as people screamed and ran in the street. A hospital in the district of Ende in East Nusa Tenggara Province was moving patients outside, Kompas TV footage showed. BMKG recorded the first quake at 4:58 a.m. (2158 GMT) at a depth of 15 km (9 miles), followed by several aftershocks.

logs.summary: Severe monsoon rains and cyclones have caused widespread flooding across the Philippines, particularly in Luzon, with damage nearing P4 billion in Central Luzon and P2.68 billion in infrastructure damage in the Ilocos Region, affecting over four million people. At least two brothers drowned in a submerged bypass road in Pampanga, and a baby was dramatically rescued from flash floods in Manila. In response, lawmakers are pushing for flood control master plan reviews and Senate investigations into the government's disaster response.

logs.summary:
Indonesian authorities formally called off the 10-day search for eight people, including five journalists, missing since early September near Mount Anak Krakatau, with no signs of life found. Separately, fact-checking reports debunked false claims that volcanic gases from the eruption posed a new toxic threat to Malaysia, while coverage also highlighted ongoing volcanic ash spread across four Indonesian volcanoes and the diversion of flights to Kertajati due to ash.
On September 21, 2026, Indonesia lowered Mount Anak Krakatau's alert status to Alert Level II, indicating reduced volcanic activity. Separately, the Indonesian press council honored the five missing journalists as 'Heroes of the Press,' and BRIN researchers simulated ocean currents to trace their possible paths after they lost contact.

In Da Nang, 40 households were evacuated due to hill cracks and rising water, while Ho Chi Minh City saw streets submerged during rush hour, stranding commuters. Authorities in Khánh Hòa and other provinces issued flood warnings as river levels rose in the Dong Nai River and elsewhere.

news.headline: Rush-hour downpour paralyzes Ho Chi Minh City, stranding commuters in deep floods
news.body: Several streets in Ho Chi Minh City were submerged after heavy rain on Tuesday afternoon, with floodwater rising above motorcycle wheels in some areas and disrupting rush-hour travel.

news.headline: Khánh Hòa steps up flood precautions as heavy rain looms
news.body: Khánh Hòa Provincial steering committee for civil defence issued a warning to localities to prepare for heavy rain, floods, landslides, tornadoes, lightning, hail and severe weather.

news.headline: Flood risk rises as heavy rain persists across central, southern Vietnam
news.body: Floodwaters in the Dong Nai River and several rivers in central Vietnam are rising as widespread heavy rain, particularly in upstream areas, continues to affect the region, according to Vietnam's meteorological agency.

news.headline: Heavy rain floods roads, causes congestion in central Dong Nai | DTiNews
news.body: More than two hours of heavy rain flooded many central roads in Dong Nai City on Tuesday evening.

news.headline: Heavy rain, hill cracks prompt evacuation of 40 households in Da Nang
news.body: Heavy rain has lashed several areas of Da Nang City in central Vietnam, with rainfall forecast to continue and totals expected to exceed 250mm in some places, raising the risk of landslides, flash floods, thunderstorms, and strong winds.

news.headline: Tropical convergence zone, low-pressure area bring heavy rain to central, southern Vietnam
news.body: A tropical convergence zone and a low-pressure area have caused moderate to heavy rain to central and southern Vietnam, according to the National Center for Hydro-Meteorological Forecasting.

logs.summary: On September 23, 2026, heavy rain persisted across central and southern Vietnam, with forecasts of over 250 mm in parts of central Vietnam and high tides elevating flood risks in Ho Chi Minh City through September 25. Flooding disrupted traffic in Phu Quoc, and authorities in Khánh Hòa warned residents not to be complacent amid ongoing flood threats.

news.headline: Heavy rain floods central Phu Quoc | DTiNews
news.body: Heavy rain flooded several major roads in Phu Quoc Speical Zone on Monday evening, disrupting traffic and daily life, with further downpours forecast over the next two days.

news.body: HCM City is forecast to see more heavy rain through September 25 as high tides add to flood risks in low-lying areas following days of widespread downpours.

news.headline: Ho Chi Minh City braces for continued heavy rain and flooding amid high tides
news.body: Ho Chi Minh City and neighboring provinces will face continued heavy downpours through Friday, exacerbating flood risks as the severe weather collides with rising high tides.

news.headline: Heavy rain of over 250 mm forecast for central Vietnam | DTiNews
news.body: Torrential rain is forecast across parts of central Vietnam on Wednesday, with some areas expected to receive more than 250 mm and face heightened risks of flooding, flash floods and landslides.

logs.summary: At least four people were killed as floods inundated more than 16,000 homes in northern and central Vietnam. Heavy rain also caused red sand and mud floods on Nguyen Thong Road in Lam Dong Province on September 23, and submerged Bui Vien walking street in Ho Chi Minh City, disrupting traffic.

news.headline: At least 4 killed as floods inundate more than 16,000 homes in Vietnam
news.body: At least four people were killed in heavy rains, floods and landslides in northern and central Vietnam, authorities said Friday.

logs.summary: Flooding in Lam Dong Province forced evacuations as heavy rain and reservoir discharges inundated residential areas. In Dong Nai City, a woman drowned and 286 households were affected. Torrential rain continued in the central region on September 25 with localised falls above 150 mm forecast from Nghe An to Quang Tri.

news.headline: Heavy rain cause widespread flooding in Lam Dong | DTiNews
news.body: Prolonged heavy rain, upstream flows and reservoir discharges have flooded residential areas and roads across Lam Dong Province, forcing some residents to evacuate.

news.headline: Floods in Dong Nai leave one dead and hundreds affected | DTiNews
news.body: Severe flooding in Dong Nai City has affected 286 households, inundated farmland and fish ponds, and claimed the life of one woman swept away by floodwaters.

news.body: The Đắk Lắk Province People’s Committee has instructed local authorities to closely monitor weather developments and immediately respond to the threats of flash floods and landslides caused by prolonged heavy rain.
